source_caption_text:
Quavo is making sure his daughter grows up knowing who Takeoff was 🥹❤️🚀

Before the fame, the hits, and the sold-out shows, they were family. Takeoff was Quavo’s nephew, and together they built a legacy that reached far beyond Atlanta.

Now, seeing Quavo keep his memory alive for the next generation makes this moment even more meaningful. His daughter will get to discover the music, but she’ll also get to hear the stories about the person behind it—from someone who knew and loved him.

Forever Takeoff 🕊️🚀
